interview.secured: The app never showed me the phrase "Day secured" on the screen I can see, so I'm guessing it means you've done your daily Show up and the streak is safe for today, but the app didn't explain it.
interview.freeze: I used one after missing a day last week and it kept my streak going, but the screens I saw never explained how you earn one or how many you get.
interview.selfReported: It's listed next to "No Days Off · Day 35 of 75" and I take it to mean you mark the task done yourself with no verification, though the app never spelled that out.
interview.tomorrow: 8 - I'm on a 33-day streak and Show up is still waiting today, so I'll be back, even though some terms like freeze and secured are unclear.

goals.text: You have used GRIIT for about a month. Open your profile and scroll through every one of your posts to the end. Then go to Home and compare the numbers: does the streak and the day number on Home match what your profile says? Say in your thought every number that does not match.
